newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee market paralysed by futures run-up.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee market paralysed by futures run-up.

text.p: Physical coffee buyers in Bremen withdrew from the market in the wake of this week's stunning run-up to 20-year price highs, traders said.
Futures were last headed south amid profit-taking but the effect of high futures and differentials meant arabicas cost between $35 and $49 more per 50 kg fob here than last week.
Industry and trade had taken some Brazilian new crop in recent weeks so that less activity was seen in this sector.
Robustas were more competitive but sales were thin.
Weather developments in Brazilian coffee areas remain the key fundamental factor guiding medium-term consumer behaviour.
